cases.name: dependency-update
cases.prompt: Update one parser dependency to the latest allowed minor version.
cases.expected_behavior: Classify dependency-maintenance mode, summarize changelog/license/lockfile impact, run narrow tests, and route high-risk parser surface to security review.

cases.name: release-prep
cases.prompt: Prepare release readiness for the workspace spec package.
cases.expected_behavior: Identify version source, artifact inventory, compatibility notes, validation, security review status, rollback, and publication gates.

cases.name: ci-change
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect workflow references, pin mutable reusable workflows or dependencies where appropriate, review permissions, and run local validation.
